summary: Ecopetrol S.A. filed a Form 6-K disclosing the temporary suspension of its tender offer (OPAV) in Brazil by its subsidiary Ecopetrol Investimentos do Brasil Ltda. The suspension follows requests for adjustments from the Brazilian Securities and Exchange Commission (CVM). The tender offer was initially announced on May 25, 2026. The auction is expected to resume on a date determined by the CVM once adjustments are approved and conditions precedent are satisfied. No other deal terms (price per share, premium, expected close) are disclosed. Investors should watch for regulatory clearance updates and the resumption timeline in Brazil.
